title: A deterministic sin^2-type algorithm for complex cubic irrationalities with exact periodicity certificates
summary: Hermite asked in 1848 for a representation of real numbers whose eventual periodicity characterizes cubic irrationals. The totally real case was solved by Karpenkov's $\sin^2$-algorithm; the complex case, signature (1,1), is his Problem 4. We study a deterministic algorithm implementing his suggested analytic extension: the score expression is strictly negative on (1,1) data (closed form proved), the most negative score is selected, and exact score ties are resolved by a declared ordering.
